headline: Andhra Pradesh targets 50% women’s workforce participation
summary: Andhra Pradesh aims to increase its women's workforce participation rate from 35.8% to 50% by expanding opportunities across manufacturing, industry, and natural farming. Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu highlighted key drivers such as existing industrial hubs like Sri City and Brandix Apparel City, as well as upcoming regional manufacturing projects. However, the state has not announced a specific timeline for achieving the 50% target.

headline: Tencent denies plans to cut half its workforce, says AI restructuring remarks were misinterpreted
summary: Tencent has denied reports suggesting it plans to cut its workforce by 50 percent following executive remarks regarding its AI transformation strategy. Management clarified that internal comments dividing focus between core operations and AI innovation signaled resource reallocation rather than mass job cuts. The company is restructuring to streamline management and improve operational efficiency as it increases investment in AI.

headline: Acquelia Colaco takes charge as CPO at Omnicom Global Solutions
summary: Omnicom Global Solutions (OGS) has appointed Acquelia Colaco as Chief People Officer for India and the Philippines to lead its People and Culture function across both markets. Colaco brings over two decades of human resources leadership experience, having previously served in executive talent roles at organizations such as XBP Global, Tesco, Infosys, and IBM. Based in Bengaluru, she will focus on talent strategy, workforce transformation, and leadership development to support the company's next phase of growth.

headline: Shaveta Kapoor moves to Leonardo DRS as CHRO
summary: Shaveta Kapoor has been appointed as Chief Human Resources Officer at Leonardo DRS, where she will collaborate with leadership to support the company's strategic growth priorities. Kapoor brings over 15 years of experience in human resources, M&A, and operational transformation, previously serving as CHRO at ASRC Federal and holding multiple executive roles at Serco. She holds an MBA from Georgetown University's McDonough School of Business.

headline: Sharad Mate takes charge of HR operations at Mahyco
summary: Sharad Mate has been appointed as the Head of HR Operations at Mahyco, where he will focus on process efficiency, technology integration, and operational strengthening. Mate has been with Mahyco for nearly seven years across various HR roles, following an 11-year tenure at Varroc. He brings extensive experience in industrial relations, HR digitization, and talent management within manufacturing environments.

headline: Ranjeeka Sachdev to lead HR at BMW Group India
summary: BMW Group India has appointed Ranjeeka Sachdev as its new Chief Human Resources Officer. Sachdev brings over 23 years of human resources experience to the role, having previously served in senior leadership positions at companies including Jaquar Group and Pernod Ricard. In her new position, she will oversee the luxury automaker's people strategy, leadership development, and organizational transformation.

headline: PVH to cut around 1,040 jobs globally, targeting office-based roles
summary: PVH Corp plans to eliminate approximately 1,040 office-based roles, representing 4% of its global workforce, as part of an ongoing effort to simplify operations and trim costs. The decision follows a weak second quarter, during which the retail giant reported a $102.9 million net loss and a 3.23% decline in sales. The corporate cuts will primarily affect non-customer-facing positions under the company's multi-year PVH+ Plan.

headline: Tata Power grants 64.88 lakh stock options to eligible employees
summary: Tata Power has approved the grant of nearly 64.89 lakh stock options to eligible employees under its ESOP 2023 scheme. Priced at Rs 360 each, the options will vest over a period of one to three years with an exercise window of up to two years post-vesting. The incentive plan coincides with the company's expanded investments in renewable energy and power distribution, backed by nearly Rs 10,000 crore in first-half FY27 capex.

headline: PLI schemes generate just 28% of targeted jobs, raising questions over manufacturing employment
summary: India's Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes have generated only 28% of their 3 million targeted jobs by FY26, despite reaching 76% of their investment goals. While sectors like electronics manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and telecom are performing well, NITI Aayog notes that overall capital investment has not automatically translated into proportional workforce expansion. The assessment recommends moving away from a uniform policy model toward sector-specific talent strategies and demand-side incentives.

headline: The career advantages nobody teaches you to cultivate
summary: HR leaders highlight that subtle skills—such as compelling storytelling, empathetic listening, and strategic lateral career moves—often drive long-term success more than formal qualifications alone. Effective communication and deep listening allow professionals to connect with stakeholders and resolve complex issues by addressing underlying concerns rather than just surface positions. Additionally, prioritizing strategic learning opportunities over immediate financial or title gains can better prepare individuals for future leadership.

headline: Rising Star: Kavita Kulwant on why AI should take the administrative load, not the human responsibility
summary: Kavita Kulwant, a total rewards professional at Tata Consultancy Services, has developed two AI agents to automate routine HR administrative tasks. By delegating clerical workloads to technology, she aims to free up HR professionals to focus on strategic decision-making, complex problem-solving, and employee engagement. Kulwant emphasizes that AI should enhance and create space for human judgment rather than replace it.

headline: Yugavel Manickam is now CHRO, Suguna Foods
summary: Suguna Foods has appointed Yugavel Manickam as its new Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO). Manickam brings extensive HR leadership experience, having previously served in senior roles at Thermax, Wittur Group, Saint-Gobain, Eid Parry, and Reliance Retail. In his new position, he aims to drive the poultry conglomerate's people strategy, corporate culture, and business growth.

headline: Vedanta sets 35% women’s representation target across management
summary: Vedanta Group has mandated a minimum 35% representation of women across all management levels to foster a more gender-inclusive workforce. Chairman Anil Agarwal urged corporate India to adopt similar targets, emphasizing that equal pay and leadership development for women are vital for broad economic growth. The move highlights strategic imperatives for HR leaders around talent pipelines, succession planning, and retention.

headline: Innoviz Technologies to cut 20% of workforce
summary: Israeli LiDAR manufacturer Innoviz Technologies is laying off 80 employees, representing 20% of its workforce, following a one-year production delay with a major automotive client that strained expected revenues. This marks the company's third consecutive year of job cuts as ongoing execution delays and cash burn have heavily eroded its market valuation. To help offset a quarterly cash burn of roughly $15 million, Innoviz recently raised $30 million to reinforce its balance sheet.

headline: Centre allows govt officers to retain official laptops after 4 years
summary: India's Finance Ministry has revised procurement rules allowing central government officers to retain government-issued laptops and tablets after four years of use, subject to data wiping. The updated guidelines also raise the device purchase cost ceiling up to Rs 1.8 lakh for equipment meeting local content criteria and allow early-departing employees to retain devices by paying a depreciated value.

headline: Housing.com elevates Priyam Sachan as senior director of marketing
summary: Housing.com has promoted Priyam Sachan to Senior Director of Marketing, elevating him from his previous role as director of marketing and growth which he assumed in August 2024. In this expanded position, Sachan will continue to lead the company's brand, performance, product marketing, and growth strategies across 40 cities. Prior to joining Housing.com, he held various marketing leadership roles at firms including Simplilearn, Zomato, Gaana, and Sahicoin.

headline: FMC Media executes Ubon transit campaign across six states
summary: Media agency FMC Media has rolled out a customized transit advertising campaign for consumer electronics brand Ubon across six Indian states. The campaign features 'Innovation Cabs' fitted with prominent Ubon branding and large rooftop headphone installations to target urban, semi-urban, and rural areas. First commissioned for a dealer meet, the initiative showcases FMC Media's ability to rapidly execute nationwide below-the-line brand activations.

headline: Dentsu India names Imtiyaz Vilatra as Chief Commercial Officer
summary: Dentsu India has appointed Imtiyaz Vilatra as its Chief Commercial Officer, expanding his current position as Chief Executive Officer of Posterscope. In this expanded role, Vilatra will focus on driving commercial effectiveness, improving client profitability, and addressing operational challenges across the agency network. He brings over 25 years of experience in the out-of-home media sector to the new mandate.

headline: Origami elevates Kushagra Sharma to CMO & business head
summary: Origami Cellulo has appointed Kushagra Sharma as its Chief Marketing Officer and Business Head to lead the company's sales and marketing strategies across domestic and international markets. Sharma previously served as Origami's group head of marketing, digital ecosystem, and emerging business. His career also spans senior leadership positions at companies such as RSPL Group, Emami, and Artsana Group.

headline: Gulshan Grover asks 'Gold Kahan Hai?' in GetLook's new campaign
summary: Beauty and wellness brand GetLook has launched a digital video campaign featuring actor Gulshan Grover to promote its premium Korean 24K Gold Hydra Facial. The humorous campaign leverages Grover's iconic screen persona to boost brand recall while highlighting the company's high-end skincare offerings. Additionally, the initiative signals GetLook's strategic plan to expand into the men's grooming category.

headline: Starcom India elevates Chirag Chandiramani to vice president
summary: Starcom India has promoted Chirag Chandiramani to Vice President following five years with the agency. During his tenure, Chandiramani has led key client accounts, including Meta, AB InBev, and P&G India. Prior to joining Starcom, he held strategic and media roles at firms such as Merkle Sokrati, Dentsu Webchutney, and Madhouse.

headline: Essential Features to Look for When Choosing Your First Trading App
summary: Selecting a first trading app requires balancing essential functionality with user experience, security, and cost structures. Key features to evaluate include intuitive interfaces, robust security like two-factor authentication, straightforward order placement, and reliable portfolio tracking. Investors should also prioritize apps that offer clear fee disclosures and accessible market information to support informed decision-making.

headline: Giant mystery gift box appears at Mumbai’s Carter Road
summary: A 10-foot mystery red gift box installation was set up at Mumbai's Carter Road as part of an unbranded teaser marketing campaign. The setup encouraged passersby and digital influencers to share guesses online using specific hashtags ahead of a scheduled reveal on November 12. The brand or organization behind the publicity stunt has not yet been disclosed.

headline: IMO calls on States to enforce maritime rules in Hormuz
source_publication: Transportation | Logistics | Aviation | Shipping | Supply Chain
summary: The International Maritime Organization (IMO) has called on member states to strictly enforce maritime safety and security regulations in the Strait of Hormuz following more than 130 attacks on commercial ships since February 2026. IMO Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez highlighted rising risks from substandard and non-compliant vessels while advising shipowners to avoid exposing crews to dangerous commercial operations. He also urged governments to pursue political solutions to resolve the underlying conflict and restore safe international navigation.
